description: DCR Office of Resilience Planning – Public File Repository is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "floods", published or maintained by Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation. The Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation’s Office of Resilience Planning maintains this public file repository to provide access to flood resilience open data products. The repository is designed to house public data produced for the Virginia Coastal Resilience Master Plan (CRMP), Virginia Flood Protection Master Plan (VFPMP), and other purposes. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag floods and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Every 5 years or as data becomes available. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "Conditions of Release - Data is available by permission of the Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation." on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
